info.title: Rolla Developer API
info.description: API for programmatic transaction management on the Rolla platform. Monetary `amount` fields use the smallest unit of the referenced currency unless an endpoint says otherwise (e.g. NGN = kobo, USD = cents, where **100 cents = USD 1.00**).

get.description: Returns every Nigerian bank supported on the platform, with its name and NIP institution code. Use `bankCode` when looking an account up or saving an NGN beneficiary.

banks.description: The full list, in alphabetical order by bank name.

401.description: Unauthorized — invalid or missing API key

500.description: The bank list could not be read

post.description: Validates a Nigerian bank account number and returns the account holder's name from NIP name enquiry. Nigerian accounts only.

400.description: Bad request — a missing bank code or account number, or a currency other than NGN

401.description: Unauthorized — invalid or missing API key

404.description: No bank recognises that account number

example.message: Account not found. Please verify the account number and bank are correct.

500.description: The name enquiry could not be completed

get.description:
A page of your transactions, newest first. Filters on status and a date range only; use `GET /wallet/transactions` to also filter by currency, type or reference.

Transactions with status `failed` are left out unless you ask for them with `status=failed`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Rows per page.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status. `completed` also returns pending transactions operations have already claimed, which are reported as completed.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Inclusive start, `YYYY-MM-DD` or a full ISO-8601 timestamp.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Inclusive end, `YYYY-MM-DD` or a full ISO-8601 timestamp.

post.description: Send funds to another Rolla business instantly and fee-free. Identify the recipient by email, Rolla tag, or a saved beneficiaryId. Requires an API key with at least one whitelisted IP.

amount.description: Amount in the smallest currency unit for the given `currency` (e.g. kobo for NGN, cents for USD — 100 cents = $1.00 USD). Must be a whole number and at least 1.

destinationCurrency.description: Recipient currency code. Differ it from `currency` for a cross-currency transfer.

recipient.description: Recipient email or Rolla tag. Required if beneficiaryId not provided.

beneficiaryId.description: Saved beneficiary ID with withdrawal_method rolla_transfer. Required if recipient not provided.

description.description: Transfer description. Defaults to "In-network transfer" when omitted or blank.

saveBeneficiary.description: Auto-save the recipient as a beneficiary for future transfers

rateToken.description: Required when `destinationCurrency` differs from `currency`. Obtain from GET /wallet/rates.

metadata.description: Your own key/value data, stored on the transfer and returned on the transaction and its webhooks. Always returned on the sending side; returned on the receiving side only when both accounts belong to the same owner. At most 20 keys (up to 64 characters each); values are a string (up to 500 characters), number, boolean or null — no nested objects or arrays.

transfer_reference.description: Shared reference linking both legs. Each leg carries it as its own `external_reference` suffixed with `-DEBIT` or `-CREDIT`.

sender_transaction.description: The debit on your wallet. `transaction_type` is `withdrawal`, or `fx_withdrawal` on a cross-currency transfer.

recipient_transaction.description: The credit on the recipient's wallet, with `transaction_type` `deposit`. Null while the transfer is an unclaimed pending claim.

pending_claim.description: Set when the recipient email matches more than one Rolla business, so the funds are held until the recipient signs in and claims them. Null otherwise.

recipient_transaction_id.description: Null until the transfer is claimed — the recipient transaction is created at claim time.

amount.description: Held amount in the smallest unit of `currency`.

400.description: Bad request — insufficient balance, unknown recipient, missing rateToken on a cross-currency transfer, or a validation failure

401.description: Unauthorized — invalid or missing API key

403.description: Forbidden — the API key has no whitelisted IP configured

example.message: This endpoint requires IP whitelisting. Add at least one whitelisted IP to your API key before using withdraw.

post.description: Swaps funds from one of your wallets into another currency. Amounts are in smallest currency units in both directions. Pass a rateToken from GET /wallet/rates to execute at that quoted rate.

400.description: Validation failed, the two currencies are the same, the corridor is not enabled, the rateToken is not usable, or the source wallet has insufficient funds

401.description: Unauthorized - invalid or missing API key

post.description: Initiates a withdrawal from your wallet to a beneficiary. Either `beneficiaryId` or `inlineBeneficiary` must be provided. Requires an API key with at least one whitelisted IP. For USD international_wire, send as multipart/form-data and attach reference documents under the `documents` field.

schema.description: Required for USD `international_wire` (reference documents must be attached). Send `inlineBeneficiary` and `metadata` as single JSON-stringified fields — not as bracketed sub-fields.

amount.description: Amount in the smallest currency unit (cents for USD — 100 = $1.00).

description.description: Narration for the transaction. Required, 1-500 characters.

inlineBeneficiary.description: The full beneficiary object, JSON-stringified into one field. Multipart fields are not reconstructed into a nested object, so bracket notation (`inlineBeneficiary[account_name]=…`) will fail with 400. Either this or `beneficiaryId` is required.

beneficiaryId.description: ID of a saved beneficiary. Either this or `inlineBeneficiary` is required.

externalReference.description: Your own reference for this transaction.

deductFeesFromBalance.description: Defaults to true: the fee comes out of your wallet balance and the beneficiary receives the exact amount. Set false to take it out of the amount instead.

metadata.description: Your own key/value data, JSON-stringified into one field. Same limits as the JSON body: at most 20 keys, keys up to 64 characters, scalar values with strings up to 500 characters.

documents.description: One or more reference documents/invoices. Required for international_wire — without at least one the request fails with 400 "Reference documents/invoices are required for international wire withdrawals". Max 50MB per file.

payerNameId.description: Which of your registered affiliated payer names the beneficiary should see on this payout. Only an international wire can carry one; naming one on any other rail is a 400. Because international wire must be sent as multipart/form-data, a payout carrying payerNameId is always a multipart request. Omit to use your default payer name if you have set one, and your own business name if you have not. Requires Named Payouts to be enabled.

transaction.description: The payout as the write path serialises it. The same twelve fields are always present as on the shared Transaction schema; every other field below is omitted entirely when it does not apply, never sent as null.

transaction_type.description: `fx_withdrawal` when the payout converts into another currency.

status.description: Always `pending` on a payout created through this API; it moves on via webhook.

external_reference.description: Your `externalReference` on non-NGN bank rails; a Rolla-generated reference on NGN and Mobile Money payouts.

source_amount.description: What left your wallet: `amount + fee_amount` under the default `deductFeesFromBalance: true`.

fee_paid_by.description: Only on tenancies where a parent account pays its subaccounts fees. Absent on ordinary payouts.

uetr.description: Cross-border payouts only, and only once the rail returns it, which is never on the response to this call. Omitted (not null) until then; read it back from GET /wallet/transaction/{transactionId}.

tracking_codes.description: Rail tracking references (e.g. IMAD) once the corridor produces them. Omitted (not null) until then, so never present on this response.

metadata.description: The metadata you sent, back exactly as you sent it. Omitted entirely (not null) when you sent none.

beneficiary.description: Snapshot of the details the payout was actually sent to. Added by the withdraw controller on top of the shared transaction shape, so it IS returned here as well as by GET /wallet/transaction/{transactionId}. Omitted entirely (not null) when the payout carried no snapshot.

400.description: Bad request — validation failure, insufficient balance, a beneficiary the rail cannot pay, or a payer name that is not usable on this rail

errors.message: routing_number is required for ACH and domestic wire withdrawals

401.description: Unauthorized — invalid or missing API key

403.description: Forbidden — the API key has no whitelisted IP configured

example.message: This endpoint requires IP whitelisting. Add at least one whitelisted IP to your API key before using withdraw.

post.description: Quotes the fee for a transaction before you execute it. Fees are configured per rail and per destination country, so send the withdrawal_method (or the beneficiaryId) you will actually pay out on.

amount.description: Fee in the smallest unit of the source currency

currency.description: Currency the fee is charged in (the wallet being debited)

feeInRecipientCurrency.description: Present only on an FX quote (one that sent recipientCurrency): the same fee expressed in recipientCurrency.

paid_by.description: Present only where a parent account settles this account's fees.

charged_to_account.description: Present alongside paid_by: what this account is actually debited, which is 0 when the parent pays.

400.description: Validation failed, the currency is not supported, the beneficiaryId does not belong to your account, or withdrawal_method contradicts the rail saved on that beneficiary

401.description: Unauthorized - invalid or missing API key

get.description:
A page of the wallet transactions on your account, newest first, filterable by currency, type, status, date range and reference.

Transactions with status `failed` are left out unless you ask for them with `status=failed`.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Filter by **source** currency, so a swap is listed under the currency it was sold from rather than under both.

parameters.name: transactionType
parameters.description: Filter by type. `fee` lists fees booked as transactions of their own.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status. `completed` also returns pending transactions operations have already claimed; `pending` excludes them.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Rows per page. Caps at 100.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Inclusive start, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Inclusive end, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Match on external reference, case-insensitive substring.

400.description: Validation failed on a query parameter, or business context missing

errors.message: Number must be less than or equal to 100

401.description: Missing or invalid API key

get.description: Builds a CSV of the matching transactions and returns a **signed link** to it. The response is JSON — the file itself is fetched from `data.url`, which expires after one hour. Takes the same filters as the transaction listing, without paging; at most 10,000 rows are exported.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Filter by source currency.

parameters.name: transactionType
parameters.description: Filter by type.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Inclusive start, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Inclusive end, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Match on external reference, case-insensitive substring.

200.description: The export is ready to download

url.description: Signed download link for the CSV. Expires one hour after it is issued.

totalRecords.description: How many transactions matched the filters.

exportedRecords.description: How many were written to the file — the lower of `totalRecords` and 10,000.

truncated.description: Present and `true` only when more than 10,000 transactions matched and the file was cut short.

400.description: Validation failed on a query parameter, or business context missing

401.description: Missing or invalid API key

404.description: Nothing matched the filters, so no file was produced

example.message: No transactions found for the selected filters

500.description: The file could not be generated or its download link could not be signed

get.description:
Retrieves a specific wallet transaction by either Rolla's transaction ID (a UUID) or the `externalReference` you set when creating it. A non-UUID path segment is matched against the transaction's `external_reference`; if it matches more than one transaction in scope, the most recent is returned.

Partner (white-label tenant) keys read across their whole tenancy, so a transaction found in `GET /accounts/transactions` can be fetched here directly. Send the `X-Account-Id` header to narrow the lookup to a single account.

parameters.name: transactionId
parameters.description: Rolla's transaction ID (UUID), or the `externalReference` you set when creating the transaction.

400.description: Transaction ID is required, or business context missing

401.description: Missing or invalid API key

404.description: No transaction with that id or reference inside the scope your key can read. A transaction belonging to someone else answers identically, so ids cannot be probed.

500.description: The lookup failed

get.description: Opening and closing balances, period totals and the transactions behind them, for one currency. `currency`, `startDate` and `endDate` are all required.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Currency of the account to draw the statement for. Required.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Inclusive start of the period, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Inclusive end of the period, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

parameters.name: accountType
parameters.description: Which side of the book to draw the statement of. Omitted, wallets and credit lines of that currency are reported together.

openingBalance.description: Balance at the start of the period. Minor units of the currency (e.g. `1250` is $12.50), the same scale as the webhook payloads. See Amounts & Currencies.

closingBalance.description: Balance at the end of the period. Minor units of the currency (e.g. `1250` is $12.50), the same scale as the webhook payloads. See Amounts & Currencies.

totalCredits.description: Money in over the period. Minor units of the currency (e.g. `1250` is $12.50), the same scale as the webhook payloads. See Amounts & Currencies.

totalDebits.description: Money out over the period. Minor units of the currency (e.g. `1250` is $12.50), the same scale as the webhook payloads. See Amounts & Currencies.

transactions.description: The rows behind those totals, oldest first. Statement rows report `transaction_type` as it affected this account, so a row can read `received` or `sent` where the underlying transaction is a withdrawal, fee or deposit.

400.description: Currency missing, no account of that currency, or the statement could not be built

401.description: Missing or invalid API key

post.description: Generates a dynamic (one-time) NGN virtual account for your business. If an active dynamic account already exists and has not expired, it is returned instead.

amount.description: Expected deposit amount in kobo. Recommended for amount-specific accounts.

400.description: The account could not be generated, for example when the business has no approved KYB application

example.message: KYB application is not yet approved or still pending review

401.description: Invalid or missing API key

post.description: Generates a permanent static NGN virtual account for your business. Takes no request body: the account details are derived from your KYB application. Only one static account can exist per provider, so this returns an error if one already exists.

400.description: A static account already exists for this business, the KYB application is missing, or it is not approved yet

example.message: NOMBA virtual account already exists for this business

401.description: Invalid or missing API key

post.description: Creates (or returns the existing) permanent NGN virtual account dedicated to one of your end-users, so deposits to it can be attributed to that user via webhook. The provider requires the end-user's BVN, name and date of birth. Idempotent per `customer_identifier`: re-requesting for the same customer returns the account already on file (HTTP 200, `existing: true`) rather than creating a duplicate.

customer_identifier.description: Your own unique id for this end-user. Pass it so the account maps back to the user and re-requests are idempotent; omit it and one is generated and returned.

bvn.description: End-user's 11-digit Bank Verification Number. Validated by the provider. Never returned in responses.

date_of_birth.description: End-user's date of birth in mm/dd/yyyy format.

existing.description: `true` when an account already existed for this `customer_identifier` and was returned unchanged, `false` when a new one was created.

200.description: An account already existed for this customer_identifier and was returned unchanged

message.example: Customer virtual account already exists for this customer_identifier

existing.description: `true` when an account already existed for this `customer_identifier` and was returned unchanged, `false` when a new one was created.

example.message: Customer virtual account already exists for this customer_identifier

400.description: Validation error (`"message": "Validation failed"` with an `errors` array) or a provider rejection, for example an invalid BVN

errors.message: Bvn: bvn must be exactly 11 digits

401.description: Invalid or missing API key

get.description: Retrieves the credit lines for the authenticated business, with balances and credit limits in smallest units. The accounts sit at the top level of the response as `loans`, not under `data`.

post.description: Draws funds from a credit line into one of your wallets. The draw cannot take the outstanding balance past the credit limit. The ledger transaction and its entry pair are returned at the top level of the response, not under `data`.

transaction.description: The ledger transaction row, as recorded. Every other column of the row is present too and null (for example approved_at, transfer_direction, admin_action).

account_id.description: The loan account the draw was booked against

status.description: Always pending here: the row is read back before its entries post, even though the movement has already settled. Read the transaction back for its final status.

fee_amount.description: Smallest currency units. Sent as a string: the ledger stores it as a 64-bit integer.

source_amount.description: Smallest currency units. Sent as a string: the ledger stores it as a 64-bit integer.

destination_amount.description: Smallest currency units. Sent as a string: the ledger stores it as a 64-bit integer.

entries.description: The double-entry pair the movement was booked as, as inserted. Both read pending: they are returned before the posting step runs.

400.description: Validation failed, the loan account or destination wallet does not belong to your business, the credit line is disabled, or the draw would exceed the credit limit

401.description: Unauthorized - invalid or missing API key

transaction.description: The ledger transaction row, as recorded. Every other column of the row is present too and null (for example approved_at, transfer_direction, admin_action).

account_id.description: The wallet the repayment was booked against

status.description: Always pending here: the row is read back before its entries post, even though the movement has already settled. Read the transaction back for its final status.

fee_amount.description: Smallest currency units. Sent as a string: the ledger stores it as a 64-bit integer.

source_amount.description: Smallest currency units. Sent as a string: the ledger stores it as a 64-bit integer.

destination_amount.description: Smallest currency units. Sent as a string: the ledger stores it as a 64-bit integer.

entries.description: The double-entry pair the movement was booked as, as inserted. Both read pending: they are returned before the posting step runs.

400.description: Validation failed, the loan account or source wallet does not belong to your business, or the wallet has insufficient funds

401.description: Unauthorized - invalid or missing API key

200.description: A page of transactions across every account you manage

items.description: A transaction, with the account it belongs to. Fields that do not apply are omitted rather than returned as `null`.

id.description: Rolla's identifier for the transaction. Stable for its whole life — key your records on this.

account_id.description: The account this transaction belongs to.

transaction_type.description: What the transaction is. `fee` is a fee charged as a transaction in its own right (a parent account paying a sub-account's fee, or a white-label margin). `reversal` unwinds an earlier movement.

status.description: Where the transaction has got to. A pending transaction that operations have already claimed is reported as `completed`.

description.description: Free-text description recorded against the transaction.

external_reference.description: The reference for the transaction — the `externalReference` you sent when you created it, or one Rolla generated. Unique only within the account that set it.

fee_amount.description: Every fee attributable to this transaction, combined. Minor units of the currency (e.g. `1250` is $12.50), the same scale as the webhook payloads. See Amounts & Currencies. A fee booked as its own row carries `fee_amount: 0`, so totalling this field down a page counts each fee exactly once.

source_amount.description: Amount debited from the source account. Minor units of the currency (e.g. `1250` is $12.50), the same scale as the webhook payloads. See Amounts & Currencies.

destination_amount.description: Amount credited to the destination. Minor units of the currency (e.g. `1250` is $12.50), the same scale as the webhook payloads. See Amounts & Currencies.

exchange_rate.description: Swaps only: `destination_amount / source_amount`. Omitted on every other transaction type.

virtual_account.description: Deposits only: the account the money arrived in (or, for a mobile-money collection, the wallet it was collected from). Empty fields are dropped. Same shape as on the deposit webhook.

reference.description: Bank transfers only: your own reference for this deposit account.

phone_number.description: Mobile money only: the MSISDN funds came from.

payer.description: Fiat deposits only: who sent the money, as the rail reported it. Omitted when the rail reports nothing, and never present on crypto deposits or on payouts.

payment_rail.description: Deposits only: which rail the money arrived on. `wire_international` **is** the SWIFT case — there is no `swift` value. Omitted when the provider does not report a transfer method, and never present on payouts or crypto deposits. Not the same field as the webhook payload’s `rail`, which is `fiat` or `stablecoin`.

fee_paid_by.description: Which account the fee came off, in tenancies where a parent account pays its sub-accounts’ fees. Omitted on ordinary transactions. Reports `account` when the parent could not cover it, because that is what happened.

fee_transaction_id.description: On a movement whose fee was booked as a separate row: the id of that fee row. Omitted when the fee was taken from the transaction itself.

fee_reference.description: Reference of that fee row, in the form `FEE-XXXXXXXX`.

related_transaction_id.description: On a `fee` row: the id of the movement that incurred it — the reverse of `fee_transaction_id`.

fee_breakdown.description: Present only when a white-label partner charged a margin on top of Rolla’s fee, so `fee_amount` can be attributed to who earned each part.

amount.description: Minor units of the currency (e.g. `1250` is $12.50), the same scale as the webhook payloads. See Amounts & Currencies.

transaction_id.description: The row this part was booked as, when it was booked separately.

uetr.description: Cross-border payouts: the UETR (Unique End-to-end Transaction Reference) the payment is traced by across every bank that touches it. **Omitted** until the correspondent network assigns one — it is not returned as `null` — and never assigned on local-rail or stablecoin payouts.

tracking_codes.description: Every payment-tracking reference recorded against the payout, keyed by name — the `UETR`, plus `IMAD` on corridors that produce one. Omitted while there are none.

metadata.description: The metadata you attached when you created the transaction, back exactly as you sent it. Omitted when you sent none.

schema.description: Returned when `format=csv`. Columns: `transaction_id`, `account_id`, `account_name`, `transaction_type`, `status`, `source_amount`, `source_currency`, `destination_amount`, `destination_currency`, `fee_amount`, `external_reference`, `fee_reference`, `related_reference`, `created_at`, `updated_at`. destination_amount.description: Amount credited to the destination. Minor units of the currency (e.g. `1250` is $12.50), the same scale as the webhook payloads. See Amounts & Currencies.

virtual_account.description: Deposits only: the account the money arrived in (or, for a mobile-money collection, the wallet it was collected from). Empty fields are dropped. Same shape as on the deposit webhook.

reference.description: Bank transfers only: your own reference for this deposit account.

phone_number.description: Mobile money only: the MSISDN funds came from.

payer.description: Fiat deposits only: who sent the money, as the rail reported it. Omitted when the rail reports nothing, and never present on crypto deposits or on payouts.

payment_rail.description: Which rail an incoming **deposit** arrived on. `ach` is US domestic ACH, `wire_domestic` a US domestic wire, and `wire_international` an international (SWIFT) wire. Present on USD bank deposits once the provider reports the transfer method, and on sandbox simulated deposits; **omitted** when the method is not reported, and never present on payouts or crypto deposits. Not the same field as the webhook payload’s `rail`, which is `fiat` or `stablecoin`.

fee_paid_by.description: Which account the fee came off, in tenancies where a parent account pays its sub-accounts’ fees. Omitted on ordinary transactions. Reports `account` when the parent could not cover it, because that is what happened.

fee_transaction_id.description: On a movement whose fee was booked as a separate row: the id of that fee row. Omitted when the fee was taken from the transaction itself.

fee_reference.description: Reference of that fee row, in the form `FEE-XXXXXXXX`.

related_transaction_id.description: On a `fee` row: the id of the movement that incurred it — the reverse of `fee_transaction_id`.

fee_breakdown.description: Present only when a white-label partner charged a margin on top of Rolla’s fee, so `fee_amount` can be attributed to who earned each part.

amount.description: Minor units of the currency (e.g. `1250` is $12.50), the same scale as the webhook payloads. See Amounts & Currencies.

transaction_id.description: The row this part was booked as, when it was booked separately.

uetr.description: Cross-border payouts: the UETR (Unique End-to-end Transaction Reference) the payment is traced by across every bank that touches it. **Omitted** until the correspondent network assigns one — it is not returned as `null` — and never assigned on local-rail or stablecoin payouts.

tracking_codes.description: Every payment-tracking reference recorded against the payout, keyed by name — the `UETR`, plus `IMAD` on corridors that produce one. Omitted while there are none.

metadata.description: The metadata you attached when you created the transaction, back exactly as you sent it. Omitted when you sent none.

beneficiary.description: Who a payout was sent to. Returned on payout transactions — by `POST /wallet/withdraw` when the payout is created, and by `GET /wallet/transaction/{transactionId}` when it is read back. **Omitted**, not `null`, when the transaction has no beneficiary; the transaction listings never carry it.

Pagination.description: Paging block used by the listings that nest one. The transaction listings do not: they return `totalCount`, `page`, `pageSize` and `totalPages` flat alongside `transactions`.

totalPages.description: How many pages there are in total.

Wallet.description: A currency wallet as the external API returns it, in smallest units.

balance.description: Balances in the smallest unit of the wallet currency.

availableBalance.description: Spendable balance: posted credits less posted and pending debits, already net of lienAmount. Check a withdrawal against this figure.

postedBalance.description: Posted balance. Pending debits have not been deducted from it.

pendingBalance.description: Amount held by transactions that have not posted.

lienAmount.description: Portion reserved by Rolla and unavailable for withdrawal. Already excluded from availableBalance.

rate.description: Units of toCurrency per one unit of fromCurrency

rateToken.description: Signed token that locks this rate. Pass it as rateToken on POST /wallet/swap.

fromCurrency.description: Currency being sold. Currency code, 3 or 4 letters, upper-cased by the server (for example NGN, USD, USDC).

toCurrency.description: Currency being bought. Must differ from fromCurrency. Currency code, 3 or 4 letters, upper-cased by the server (for example NGN, USD, USDC).

fromAmount.description: Amount to sell, in the smallest unit of fromCurrency. Whole number of the smallest currency unit (kobo for NGN, cents for USD). Fractional values and amounts below 1 are rejected with a 400.

description.description: Your own description for the transaction. Omitted, Rolla writes one naming the rate and the two amounts.

rateToken.description: rateToken from GET /wallet/rates, to execute at that quoted rate. Omitted, the swap executes at the current market rate.

amount.description: Amount in smallest units (kobo for NGN; US cents for USD — 100 = 1 USD). Must be a whole number and at least 1.

currency.description: Currency code of the wallet the payout leaves

description.description: Narration for the transaction. Required, 1-500 characters after trimming.

externalReference.description: Your own unique reference for this transaction. Used on USD and other non-NGN bank rails. NGN and Mobile Money payouts always get a Rolla-generated reference instead (e.g. `NG-NFNUJTUW`), because the provider imposes its own format.

beneficiaryId.description: ID of a saved beneficiary. Use this OR inlineBeneficiary.

inlineBeneficiary.description: One-time beneficiary details (use instead of beneficiaryId)

saveBeneficiary.description: Save the inline beneficiary for future use

deductFeesFromBalance.description: Defaults to true on this API: the fee is taken from your wallet balance on top of `amount` and the beneficiary receives the exact `amount`. Set false to take the fee out of the amount instead, so the beneficiary receives less.

metadata.description: Your own key/value data, stored verbatim on the transaction and returned on every response and webhook for it. At most 20 keys; keys up to 64 characters; values must be a string (up to 500 characters), number, boolean or null — not nested objects or arrays.

payerNameId.description: Which of your registered affiliated payer names the beneficiary should see on this payout. Only an international wire can carry one; naming one on any other rail is a 400. Because international wire must be sent as multipart/form-data, a payout carrying payerNameId is always a multipart request. Omit to use your default payer name if you have set one, and your own business name if you have not. Requires Named Payouts to be enabled.

InlineBeneficiary.description: One-time beneficiary details (use instead of `beneficiaryId`). Which fields are required depends on the currency and `withdrawal_method` — see the per-currency tables on the endpoint page. On `ach`, `domestic_wire` and `international_wire`, both `bank_address` and `beneficiary_address` must carry a full street, city, state, postalCode and two-letter country, and `ach` / `domestic_wire` additionally require `routing_number`.

withdrawal_method.description: The payout rail. Required for USD, GBP, EUR, crypto and Mobile Money. NGN defaults to local transfer. `rolla_transfer` beneficiaries cannot be paid here — use POST /wallet/transfer instead.

account_name.description: Account holder name. Required for all currencies except EUR SEPA. For crypto, used as a display nickname. On Mobile Money it is replaced by the name the provider returns when it verifies the number.

account_number.description: Required for NGN, USD, GBP local (8 digits), GBP international, EUR international. Not required for EUR SEPA, crypto or Mobile Money.

bank_name.description: Required for NGN, USD, GBP. Not required for EUR SEPA, crypto or Mobile Money.

bank_code.description: Required for NGN (e.g. '000014' for Access Bank). See GET /banks.

routing_number.description: 9-digit ABA routing number. Required for USD `ach` and `domestic_wire` — omitting it returns 400 "routing_number is required for ACH and domestic wire withdrawals".

swift_code.description: Required for USD international_wire, GBP international_wire, EUR international_wire, and other currencies.

sort_code.description: Required for GBP local_transfer. Must be exactly 6 digits.

bank_address.description: The beneficiary bank's postal address. Every part is required on `ach`, `domestic_wire` and `international_wire`, and `country` must be a two-letter ISO 3166-1 code.

country.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. US or GB.

beneficiary_address.description: The beneficiary's own postal address. Every part is required on `ach`, `domestic_wire` and `international_wire`, and `country` must be a two-letter ISO 3166-1 code.

country.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. US or GB.

account_owner_type.description: Whether the beneficiary is a person or a company. Carried onto the saved record when `saveBeneficiary` is true.

account_category.description: US account type. Recommended on USD bank rails and carried onto the saved record when `saveBeneficiary` is true.

wallet_address.description: Required for crypto_usdt and crypto_usdc. Use with currency: USD.

wallet_chain.description: Required for crypto_usdt and crypto_usdc. The blockchain network slug (e.g. 'ethereum', 'tron'). Resolved against Rolla's network registry at request time, so a chain that cannot currently carry this stablecoin is refused with 400 and the list of supported networks.

mobile_money_provider.description: Required for withdrawal_method `mobile_money`: the operator slug, e.g. 'mtn-momo-ghana'. The number is verified with the provider before the payout is created.

phone_number.description: Required for withdrawal_method `mobile_money`: the recipient's Mobile Money number.

intermediary_bank_name.description: Optional. Intermediary bank for USD international_wire.

intermediary_bank_routing_number.description: Optional. Intermediary bank routing number for USD international_wire.

currency.description: Optional. The beneficiary's payout currency. Defaults to the withdrawal `currency`, and must match it.

contact_person.description: Optional. Contact person at the beneficiary.

label.description: Optional. Nickname for the beneficiary record saved when `saveBeneficiary` is true.

currency.description: Currency of the wallet being debited. Currency code, 3 or 4 letters, upper-cased by the server (for example NGN, USD, USDC).

transactionType.description: Type of transaction the fee is quoted for

amount.description: Transaction amount, in the smallest unit of currency. Whole number of the smallest currency unit (kobo for NGN, cents for USD). Fractional values and amounts below 1 are rejected with a 400.

recipientCurrency.description: For FX payouts, the currency the beneficiary receives. The response then also carries feeInRecipientCurrency.

destination_country.description: Two-letter country code of the destination bank, for fees scoped to a corridor. Upper-cased by the server.

withdrawal_method.description: Payout rail to price. Fees are configured per rail, so an ACH and a wire to the same bank are usually priced differently; send the rail you will actually withdraw on. Omitted, the currency-level fee is quoted. Sending one that contradicts the saved rail of a beneficiaryId is rejected with a 400.

beneficiaryId.description: Quote a saved beneficiary: destination_country and withdrawal_method are read from it when not supplied. The beneficiary must belong to your account, and an id that resolves to nothing returns a 400 rather than a default fee.

VirtualAccount.description: A virtual account as the external API returns it. Fields that are empty for the account are omitted, so a fiat account carries bank details and a crypto account carries a wallet address instead.

status.description: Account status

bank_address.description: USD fiat accounts only. Empty parts of the address are omitted.

expires_at.description: Dynamic accounts only: when the account stops accepting deposits.

balance.description: Balances in the smallest unit of the loan currency. postedBalance is the amount currently drawn.

availableBalance.description: Spendable balance: posted credits less posted and pending debits, already net of lienAmount. Check a withdrawal against this figure.

postedBalance.description: Posted balance. Pending debits have not been deducted from it.

pendingBalance.description: Amount held by transactions that have not posted.

lienAmount.description: Portion reserved by Rolla and unavailable for withdrawal. Already excluded from availableBalance.

virtualAccounts.description: Empty on a credit line: funds are drawn into a wallet, not paid in.

credit_limit.description: Total credit available on the line, in smallest units. The credit still undrawn is this minus balance.postedBalance.

interest_rate.description: Annual interest rate as a percentage. Not an amount, so never converted to smallest units.

loanAccountId.description: Loan account, from GET /wallet/loans. Must belong to your business.

destinationWalletId.description: Wallet to receive the funds. Must belong to your business.

amount.description: Amount in the smallest unit of the loan currency. Whole number of the smallest currency unit (kobo for NGN, cents for USD). Fractional values and amounts below 1 are rejected with a 400.

description.description: Your own description for the transaction

loanAccountId.description: Loan account, from GET /wallet/loans. Must belong to your business.

sourceWalletId.description: Wallet the repayment is taken from. Must belong to your business.

amount.description: Amount in the smallest unit of the loan currency. Whole number of the smallest currency unit (kobo for NGN, cents for USD). Fractional values and amounts below 1 are rejected with a 400.

description.description: Your own description for the transaction

SavedBeneficiary.description: A saved beneficiary as returned to API-key callers. Only populated fields are included: a fiat beneficiary never carries wallet fields and a crypto beneficiary never carries bank fields, and empty values are dropped. `withdrawal_method` is always present and is null when no rail was set. Timestamps and internal ids (business_id, recipient_business_id) are not returned.

account_name.description: Account holder name, or the nickname for crypto and Rolla beneficiaries

beneficiary_address.description: Postal address. On ach, domestic_wire and international_wire every part is required and country must be a two-letter ISO 3166-1 code; a missing part is rejected with a 400 naming the field (e.g. bank_address.city). Optional on every other rail.

withdrawal_method.description: Payout rail. Always present; null when the beneficiary was saved without one (NGN bank transfer).

bank_address.description: Postal address. On ach, domestic_wire and international_wire every part is required and country must be a two-letter ISO 3166-1 code; a missing part is rejected with a 400 naming the field (e.g. bank_address.city). Optional on every other rail.

account_owner_type.description: Whether the account is held by an individual or a business. Omitted on legacy records that predate this field.

account_category.description: Whether a USD account is checking or savings. Omitted on legacy records that predate this field.

wallet_chain.description: Canonical network slug the address was validated on (crypto beneficiaries only)

BeneficiaryRequest.description: Which other fields are required depends on withdrawal_method and currency; see the "Required Fields by Withdrawal Method" table on Create Beneficiary. The same schema is validated as a whole on PATCH and PUT.

currency.description: Currency code (e.g., NGN, USD). Must be a supported wallet or FX corridor currency.

account_name.description: Account holder name. Required on every rail except mobile_money (for crypto and rolla_transfer it is the nickname).

account_number.description: Bank account number. Required for ach, domestic_wire and international_wire; surrounding whitespace is trimmed.

bank_name.description: Bank name. Required for ach, domestic_wire and international_wire.

bank_code.description: Nigerian bank code from List Nigerian Banks. Required whenever currency is NGN and account_number is sent.

bank_address.description: Postal address. On ach, domestic_wire and international_wire every part is required and country must be a two-letter ISO 3166-1 code; a missing part is rejected with a 400 naming the field (e.g. bank_address.city). Optional on every other rail.

beneficiary_address.description: Postal address. On ach, domestic_wire and international_wire every part is required and country must be a two-letter ISO 3166-1 code; a missing part is rejected with a 400 naming the field (e.g. bank_address.city). Optional on every other rail.

withdrawal_method.description: Payout rail. Omit (or send null) for an NGN bank transfer. On update, omit to keep the current rail; null or "" clears it.

routing_number.description: 9-digit ABA routing number. Required for ach and domestic_wire.

wallet_address.description: Crypto wallet address (required for crypto_usdt / crypto_usdc). 26 to 64 alphanumeric characters; validated against the network.

wallet_chain.description: Blockchain network slug (required for crypto_usdt / crypto_usdc), e.g. base, tron, ethereum. Stored as the canonical slug.

iban.description: IBAN, for banks that use one instead of an account number

bic.description: BIC, where it differs from swift_code

recipient_business_id.description: Required for rolla_transfer. The UUID of the destination Rolla business (not your own).

account_owner_type.description: Whether the account is held by an individual or a business. Required for every bank-account beneficiary except NGN (ach, domestic_wire, international_wire). Accepted but not required for NGN. Not applicable to crypto_usdt, crypto_usdc, mobile_money or rolla_transfer. During the deprecation grace period, requests that omit this field still succeed but return a `deprecation_warning` object; after the enforcement date the request is rejected with a 400. See the Beneficiary Account Fields migration guide.

account_category.description: Whether a USD account is checking or savings. Required only when `currency` is USD. If you are not sure, use "checking". Subject to the same grace-period behaviour as account_owner_type.

mobile_money_provider.description: Mobile money operator slug (required for mobile_money)

phone_number.description: Mobile money wallet number (required for mobile_money)

TeamRole.description: A role that can be assigned to a team member.

id.description: Role identifier. Send this as `roleId` on an invite or `role_id` when assigning a role.

name.description: Role name. `business_owner` and `individual_owner` are reserved and never returned by this endpoint.

description.example: Can initiate transactions including sending money, but cannot approve them

email.description: Email address of the person to invite

fullname.description: Full name of the person to invite

roleId.description: Role to assign, from `GET /teams/roles`. Optional: defaults to the initiator role when omitted. A caller whose own role is initiator cannot assign `business_admin`.

TeamMember.description: A member of the business, as the team listing returns one.

id.description: Member user identifier. Use it in the `userId` path of the role, status and remove endpoints.

role.description: Assigned role name, or null when the member has no role. The former `collaborator` value is now returned as `initiator`.

role_id.description: Identifier of the assigned role, or null when the member has no role.

status.description: Whether the membership is active.

is_owner.description: True for the business owner, who cannot be removed or deactivated.

joined_at.description: When the member was added to the business.

role_id.description: UUID of the role to assign. Retrieve assignable roles from `GET /teams/roles`.

status.description: New status for the team member

code.description: Referral code, `REF-` followed by eight characters.

inviteUrl.description: Registration link carrying the referral code. Share this with businesses you refer.

ReferredBusiness.description: A business that registered through one of your referral links.

status.description: The business's own onboarding status. The KYB decision is `application_status`.

negotiation_enabled.description: Whether rate negotiation is enabled for this business.

commission_amount.description: Commission earned, in the smallest unit of commission_currency (1550 = USD 15.50).

commission_margin.description: Share of the spread earned, as a decimal string (0.01 is 1%).

KybApplication.description: The stored onboarding application row, returned as-is, so its keys are snake_case. The sections that do not apply to the account's `entity_type` come back as `null`: a business account carries `business_info`, `business_address`, `contact_info`, `banking_info` and `related_persons`; an individual account carries `individual_info`.

invite_id.description: The account this application belongs to (the `accountId` you called with)

status.description: Moves `draft` -> `submitted` -> `approved`, or to `changes_requested` / `rejected`. `deactivated`, `blacklisted` and `deleted` are reviewer-only states.

current_step.description: Onboarding step reached (1-6 for a business, 1-3 for an individual)

related_persons.description: Business accounts only: the declared beneficial owners and directors

change_request_note.description: Set when the review team requests changes: what has to be fixed before resubmitting

flagged_fields.description: Individual fields a reviewer flagged, with their resolution state

KybApplicationRequest.description: Sections of the onboarding application to write. Every field is optional; a section you send replaces the stored one wholesale, and one you leave out is left untouched.

related_persons.description: The complete list of directors and beneficial owners. A person sent without an `id` is assigned one; keep the `id` to edit an existing person, and drop them from the array to remove them.

id.description: Omit for a new person; send it to update one

ownershipPercentage.description: A percentage, not a fraction: 60 for 60%

taxId.description: The government identifier their country of residence issues. Required before a USD account can be issued.

nin.description: Nigerian residents only, 11 digits. Accepted in place of `taxId`.

current_step.description: Which onboarding step the application is on

is_complete.description: Send with status "submitted" to submit the application

status.description: Only draft and submitted may be set. Writing back the status the application already has is accepted; approved, rejected and changes_requested are reviewer decisions and are refused with 403.

BusinessInfo.description: Business details of a KYB application. No field is required by the request itself — the section is merged into the stored application — but every field except `tradingName` must be present before the application can be submitted.

tradingName.description: Name the business trades under when it differs from the legal name. Optional; the legal name is used when it is absent

incorporationCountry.description: Accepts an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, a country name or a demonym; stored as the alpha-2 code

taxId.description: The company's tax identification or business-licence (registration) number

website.description: Valid URL including the scheme. Required before submission: the USD provider rejects an entity without one

description.description: What the business does, 10 to 1000 characters
description.example: Freight and logistics services across West Africa

monthlyVolume.description: Numeric string greater than 0, decimals allowed

annualRevenue.description: Numeric string greater than 0, decimals allowed

BusinessAddress.description: Registered address. All five fields are required before the application can be submitted.

country.description: Accepts an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, a country name or a demonym; stored as the alpha-2 code

IndividualAddress.description: Residential address. `street`, `city`, `state`, `postalCode` and `country` are all required before the application can be submitted. Unlike `citizenship` and `countryOfResidence`, `country` is stored exactly as sent, so send the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.

line2.description: Secondary address line (apt/suite). Used by USD account issuance; derived from city/state when omitted

ContactInfo.description: Contact details for the application. Both fields are required before submission.

RelatedPerson.description: A beneficial owner or director on a business account’s application.

id.description: Server-generated identifier. Use it as `personId` and as `relatedPersonId` when uploading this person’s documents.

roles.description: The person's capacities on the business. Defaults to `["Beneficial Owner"]` when omitted or empty, so the stored record always has at least one role.

email.description: Where this person’s KYC link is sent

dateOfBirth.description: `YYYY-MM-DD`. The person must be 18 or older

ownershipPercentage.description: Ownership stake as a percentage, not a fraction: send `60` for 60%. A value between 0 and 1 is rejected.

currentAddress.description: Residential address. All-or-nothing: whenever the object is sent, every one of the five fields must be present.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Stored normalized to the two-letter code, and it decides which government identifier format applies to this person.

sourceOfWealthExplanation.description: Free-text explanation of where the person’s wealth comes from. Accepted empty here; required before the application can be submitted.
sourceOfWealthExplanation.example: Salary and dividends from Beta Logistics LLC

taxId.description: The person's government identifier, in the format their country of residence issues — Mainland China: 18-character resident ID; Hong Kong: HKID; United States: SSN or ITIN; elsewhere: the national ID or tax number as issued. The format is validated by the USD provider when the account is issued.

bvn.description: Bank Verification Number. Nigerian residents only; must be 11 digits when the person's `currentAddress.country` is `NG`.

nin.description: National Identification Number, accepted in place of `taxId` for Nigerian residents; must be 11 digits when the person's `currentAddress.country` is `NG`.

BankingInfo.description: The customer's existing bank details. Entirely optional — it is not part of the submit gate.

KybDocument.description: An uploaded onboarding document, returned as the stored row (snake_case keys).

file_path.description: Storage path, `<applicationId>/<documentType>/<file>`. A document belonging to one related person is stored under `<applicationId>/related-persons/<personId>/<documentType>/<file>`

Error.description: Error envelope. Some errors add further top-level fields (for example `accountBlocked`, `provider`, `missingFields`); the endpoint documents them where they apply.

status.description: HTTP status code, repeated in the body as a number

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong

code.description: Machine-readable error code, present on some errors only. See the Errors concept page for the taxonomy.

errors.description: Present on `400` validation failures: one entry per offending field

message.example: amount must be a whole number of smallest currency units (e.g. cents)

Account.description: One account owned by the same user as your API key's business, with its application status.

id.description: Account identifier — the `accountId` of every other onboarding endpoint

name.description: Business name, or the individual's full name

email.description: The account's own contact email, unique across your accounts

name.description: Business name. Required when `type` is `business`, ignored for an individual account

firstName.description: Account holder first name (individual accounts). Defaults to the owner's name

lastName.description: Account holder last name (individual accounts). Defaults to the owner's name

email.description: The account's own contact email. Required, and must be unique across your accounts — every account you onboard is a distinct customer with its own email

email.description: Optional: the account already carries its own email, set when you created it

taxId.description: Tax identifier, used as the tax number for the USD provider. Where no separate tax identifier exists, use the national ID or passport number

nin.description: Nigerian National Identification Number. 11 digits when present

bvn.description: Nigerian Bank Verification Number. 11 digits when present

identityVerification.description: Individual accounts only: identity (ID + liveness) verification state. `unknown` when the identity provider could not be reached

url.description: Hosted verification page to share with the person. Links expire after 72 hours. For white-label tenants the host is your branded subdomain

status.description: `active` until the person completes verification (`completed`), fails it (`rejected`), or the link expires or is replaced by a newer one (`expired`)

verified.description: `true` once the review completed with a positive result

reviewStatus.description: The identity provider's review state, e.g. `init`, `pending`, `completed`. `null` when verification has not started

reviewAnswer.description: `GREEN` (passed) or `RED` (failed). `null` while the review is in progress or not started

BankAccount.description: A deposit account issued for an account. Every key is always present; USD-only details are `null` on NGN accounts.

reference.description: The reference this account was issued under, or `null` on the client's primary account. Lets you tell a client's accounts apart without keeping your own mapping.

label.description: The label this account was issued with, if any.

accountData.description: Optional overrides merged over the details prefilled from the account's application. The shape depends on the provider: call GET /accounts/{accountId}/bank-accounts/requirements to see the prefilled payload and what is missing. For USD business accounts, entries in `representatives` merge into the prefilled person with the same `relatedPersonId`; USD individual accounts use `onboardingDetails` only.

reference.description:
Your own stable id for whatever you need to reconcile separately (a storefront, a branch, a marketplace, a channel). Supplying it issues an **additional** USD deposit account under the same client, with its own account number, so incoming funds are attributable to that one reference. Omit it for the client's primary account.

Idempotent: the same reference always returns the same account, so a retry cannot create a duplicate. USD only: sending it with `currency: "NGN"` returns `400`. The client must already hold its primary USD account.

label.description: Human-readable name stored alongside the account and echoed back on reads, e.g. "Amazon UK". Only meaningful together with `reference`.

amount.description: Deposit amount in major units of USD, e.g. "100" or "100.50". Must be greater than 0.

bank_account_reference.description: Which of the account's deposit accounts to credit, as passed to Issue Bank Account. Omit to credit the client's primary account. A reference with no account behind it returns `404` rather than falling back to the primary.

reference.description: Your own reference carried on the simulated transfer itself. Generated when omitted.

sender_name.description: Name recorded as the sender on the resulting transaction. Returned as `payer.name`. Defaults to "Sandbox Sender" when omitted.

payment_rail.description: Sandbox only. Rail the simulated deposit arrives on. Reported on the deposit's `payment_rail` as `ach`, `wire_domestic` (for `fedwire`) or `wire_international` (for `swift`), and charged that rail's pay-in fee.

status.description: Provider-side state of the simulated transfer; normally `submitted`. The balance is credited later via the provider webhook.

message.example: Simulated incoming USD transfer submitted. The balance will be credited to the wallet via the provider webhook.

reference.description: Reference on the simulated transfer (yours, or generated as `RL_SIM_...`).

bankAccountReference.description: Which deposit account was credited; `null` for the client's primary. Omitted when the provider sandbox does not report it.

transferId.description: The provider's id for the simulated transfer, when it returns one.

paymentRail.description: The rail the simulated deposit will arrive on.

PayerNameDocument.description: A supporting document attached to a payer name. Read by Rolla review only; never forwarded to a payout rail.

description.description: The label you sent in `documentDescriptions`, or `null` for an unlabelled file.

downloadUrl.description: Signed URL, valid for 1 hour from the time the response was generated. An empty string when the stored object is no longer available.

PayerName.description: A payer name: the name a beneficiary sees on a payout you send. Responses are camelCase; request bodies are snake_case.

name.description: The name shown to the beneficiary.

status.description: Where the payer name has got to: Rolla review and provider registration collapsed into one value. Only `active` is fully usable. Note that the `status` query filter on List Payer Names takes review statuses instead, where `approved` covers `processing`, `active` and `action_required`.

isDefault.description: Applied to payouts that do not name a payer name.

decisionNote.description: The reviewer's note, verbatim. Set on `changes_requested` and `rejected`, cleared on an update.

metadata.description: Your own flat key/value data, echoed back verbatim. Omitted entirely when you have not set any.

PayerNameRequest.description: A payer name submission. Field names are snake_case.

entity_type.description: Whether the payer is a company or a person.

display_name.description: The name the beneficiary sees. Must be unique among your payer names that are in review or approved, compared case-insensitively.

first_name.description: Individuals only. Send the name already split rather than letting us guess where to split it.

registration_number.description: Company registration number, or a government ID number for an individual.

country.description: The payer's country. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, or a country name we can resolve to one. Anything that does not resolve to two letters is rejected with a `400`.

metadata.description: Flat key/value data of your own, echoed back on responses and webhooks. Keys are at most 64 characters; values may be strings (max 500 characters), numbers or booleans. JSON requests only — a multipart request cannot carry it.

PayerNameUpdateRequest.description: Fields to change on a payer name still in review. Every field is optional; omitted fields keep their current value. Any edit returns the name to `pending_review` and clears `decisionNote`.

entity_type.description: Whether the payer is a company or a person.

display_name.description: The name the beneficiary sees. Must be unique among your payer names that are in review or approved, compared case-insensitively.

first_name.description: Individuals only. Send the name already split rather than letting us guess where to split it.

registration_number.description: Company registration number, or a government ID number for an individual.

country.description: The payer's country. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, or a country name we can resolve to one. Anything that does not resolve to two letters is rejected with a `400`.

metadata.description: Flat key/value data of your own, echoed back on responses and webhooks. Keys are at most 64 characters; values may be strings (max 500 characters), numbers or booleans. JSON requests only — a multipart request cannot carry it.

CustomerVirtualAccount.description: A permanent virtual account dedicated to one of your end-users.

customer_identifier.description: Your own id for this end-user, as sent on creation (or the generated one).

bvn_last4.description: Last 4 digits of the end-user's BVN. The full BVN is never returned.

bank_code.description: Null on providers that do not return a bank code.

DeprecationWarning.description: Present only during the grace period, when a required classification field (account_owner_type, account_category) was omitted.

message.example: The field(s) account_owner_type will soon be required for beneficiaries. account_owner_type (individual|business) is required for bank-account beneficiaries except NGN; account_category (checking|savings) is required for USD beneficiaries.

enforcement_date.description: ISO timestamp after which the request is rejected; null until the date has been set.

KybFlaggedField.description: A field a reviewer flagged while requesting changes. Resolution is recomputed on every read, so a field you have since edited comes back resolved.

feedback.example: This does not match the certificate of incorporation

value_snapshot.description: The value at the time it was flagged

resolved.description: True once the value has changed since it was flagged

not_applicable.description: True when the field is no longer collected given your other answers

KybApplicationRecord.description: The stored onboarding application. Top-level keys are snake_case; the JSON sections inside it are camelCase. A section that has never been filled in is null.

invite_id.description: The account this application belongs to

current_step.description: Which onboarding step the application is on

status.description: draft and submitted are applicant-writable; approved, rejected and changes_requested are reviewer decisions

entity_type.description: Which onboarding shape this application uses

individual_info.description: Individual accounts only; null on a business application

flagged_fields.description: Fields a reviewer flagged in the current change request

change_request_note.description: The reviewer's summary when status is changes_requested

FundingInstruction.description: How to fund one of the account's currencies. `method: bank_transfer` entries carry bank details; `method: crypto` entries carry a wallet address and network.

reference.description: bank_transfer only. The reference the deposit account was issued under, or `null` on the client's primary account.

label.description: bank_transfer only. The label the deposit account was issued with, if any.

instructions.example: Transfer USD to the bank account below. Deposits are credited to the account's USD wallet automatically.
